free_tier.stated: none listed: pay-as-you-go through an Azure subscription at $0.00667 per GB per day of storage, $0.05 per GB of egress and $0.0005 per Graph API call

egress.terms: Egress is a metered $/GB charge on all data leaving the platform, listed at $0.05 per GB, with no cap and no free allowance listed on the pricing or meters pages. Downloads to Office desktop clients and the Web Application Companion are not charged as egress. Billed through an Azure subscription.
